introduction_markdown:
**General Certificate of Education Board - Ordinary Level Examination. Computer Science (0595), Paper 3 (practical), June 2021. Duration: two and a half hours. Do all tasks (Task I, Task II, Task III) in this question paper.**

The booklet reproduced here contains three versions of the same practical paper, headed Group One, Group Two and Group Three (booklets GCE/P/2021/0595/3/C/Grp 1, Grp 2 and Grp 3). Each version has three tasks: Task I (word processing, 20 marks), Task II (spreadsheet, 20 marks) and Task III (reading and running a short C or Pascal program, 10 marks). A candidate works on one group only (the printed paper does not say how the groups are allotted).

Enter the information required in the shaded boxes. For your guidance, the approximate mark for each part of a question is indicated in brackets. You are reminded of the necessity for good English and orderly presentation in your answers. In calculations, you are advised to show all the steps in your working, giving your answer at each stage. All written answers should be provided in the spaces provided in this question booklet. Calculators are NOT allowed.

The working files named in the tasks (the picture 'CornerShop' found on the desktop, Group Two Task II) are supplied on the day; they are not reproduced in the printed paper.
enonce_intro_markdown:

incertitudes: Le PDF (18 pages, scan sans couche texte) contient TROIS versions du meme sujet pratique : « Group One » (pages 1 a 6, livret GCE/P/2021/0595/3/C/Grp 1), « Group Two » (pages 7 a 12, Grp 2) et « Group Three » (pages 13 a 18, Grp 3), chacune avec Task I (traitement de texte, 20 points), Task II (tableur, 20 points) et Task III (programme C ou Pascal, 10 points). Page de garde verifiee : ORDINARY LEVEL, COMPUTER SCIENCE, 0595, Paper 3, juin 2021, 2h30. Transcrites en neuf fichiers : numero_exercice G1-T1, G1-T2, G1-T3, G2-T1, ..., G3-T3 ; groupes ["GROUP 1"], ["GROUP 2"] ou ["GROUP 3"]. Le sujet n'impose pas expressement de ne traiter qu'une version (le candidat ne passe en pratique qu'un groupe) : non exprimable, regles_choix reste vide. De meme, a la Task III le sujet dit « Select any one of them » (programme C ou Pascal) : non exprimable.

Les filigranes gcerevision.com / Kawlo, les cadres d'en-tete (numero de centre, nom du candidat, « For examiners' use only »), les lignes a completer, les textes fantomes du verso (le papier est translucide) et les artefacts de scanner sont ignores. Le fichier-image « CornerShop » (Group Two, Task II) et les fichiers du bureau ne figurent pas dans le PDF.

Aucun logiciel (traitement de texte, tableur) n'a ete execute : les menus et les etapes sont donnes de memoire (Office recent) et ne sont pas testes. Les formules de tableur ont ete traduites en Python et executees sur les donnees du sujet (totaux, moyennes, calcul des frais, tri). Aucun compilateur C ou Pascal n'est disponible : les programmes du sujet n'ont pas ete compiles, leur logique a ete verifiee par une simulation Python fidele (division entiere et reste, memes entrees, memes sorties) dont les resultats sont recopies dans les corriges.
Aucun corrige officiel n'existe : les reponses sont redigees. Les repartitions de points dans les corriges (« marking idea ») sont indicatives ; les points imprimes du sujet ne sont jamais modifies.

Pascal : les entiers du programme sont declares « integer ». Sur un compilateur a entiers de 16 bits (maximum 32767, cas d'anciens Turbo Pascal ou du mode par defaut de certains compilateurs) une entree comme 45678 (Group One) provoque un depassement ; sur un compilateur a entiers de 32 bits (cas usuel, et int en C) le resultat est celui donne. Le corrige indique la sortie attendue sur une machine a entiers de 32 bits. En Pascal ISO la largeur d'affichage par defaut d'un entier est definie par l'implementation : le corrige suppose l'affichage sans blancs de tete (cas usuel).

Task I, Group Two : les points imprimes (1 + 1 + 4 + 4 + 4 + 4 + 2 = 20) correspondent a l'en-tete ; les questions 2 (launch) et 9 (save and print) n'ont pas de points. Les marques « (1 mark), (4 marks)... » sont decalees par le texte fantome du verso sur le scan : affectees par ligne de question (1:1, 3:1, 4:4, 5:4, 6:4, 7:4, 8:2).

Fautes d'impression recopiees telles quelles : « Format the the company's address », « Net work Manager » (tableau), « Tallahr ». Question 5 « appropriate alignment » : lu comme adresse de l'entreprise a droite et coordonnees de l'expediteur a gauche (disposition de la Figure 1). Question 7 « before the signature of the Director » : tableau place apres les deux paragraphes et avant « Yours sincerely, » et le bloc de signature ; la position exacte n'est pas imposee.

questions.enonce_markdown: State the name of the word processor installed in your computer.  *[1 mark]*
questions.corrige_markdown: The answer depends on the software installed on the candidate's computer, so give the real name found on that machine, for example **Microsoft Word** (or **LibreOffice Writer**, **WPS Writer**). It is shown in the *Start* menu or in the *About* window of the program. A correct answer names a real word processor.
Open the word processor named in question 1 (*Start* menu or desktop icon) and create a **Blank document**. No mark is printed for this step.

questions.enonce_markdown: Set the page orientation to Portrait and the page size to A4.  *[1 mark]*
questions.corrige_markdown: In the *Layout* tab (*Page Layout*), *Page Setup* group: click **Orientation** > **Portrait**, then **Size** > **A4** (21 cm x 29.7 cm). Do it before typing.

questions.enonce_markdown: Type the text given in Figure 1.  *[4 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
Type the letter exactly as printed: the four address lines (*M & M Computing*, *Sis MADO Building B.Town*, *12825 NAKURA Avenue*, *20 July 2010*), *Dear Applicant*, the two paragraphs, *Yours sincerely,* and the three lines of the sender (*John Okuko*, *Human Resource Director*, *M & M Computing*). Press *Enter* only at the end of a paragraph or of an address line; let the program wrap the lines of the paragraphs. Keep the spelling, the capital letters (*Sis MADO*, *NAKURA*), the figures (*12825*, *8 a.m.*) and the punctuation. Do not draw a border around the text.

*Marking idea:* the 4 marks reward the complete and accurate typing (indicative split).

questions.enonce_markdown:
Format the the company's address (first four lines) and sender's information (last three lines) as follows:

a. Font size: 14
b. Font name: Arial
c. Alignment: Use appropriate alignment
d. Typeface: Bold  *[4 marks]*

Format the rest of the text as follows:

a. Font size: 13
b. Line spacing: 1.5
c. Alignment: Full justification
d. Font name: Times New Roman  *[4 marks]*
Insert Table 1 before the signature of the Director  *[4 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
1. Place the insertion point after the paragraph *Come along with all the originals of your certificates and diplomas.* and before the closing *Yours sincerely,* / *John Okuko* (the signature block of the Director). Press *Enter* to make a blank line there.
2. *Insert* > **Table** > **Insert Table**: **6 columns** and **6 rows** (a header row and five rows).
3. Type the headings *S/N, TITLE, FIRST NAME, LAST NAME, Specialty, DATE*.
4. Type the five rows exactly as printed (*1. Mr John Ndebi IT Engineer 21st August 2010* ... *5. Mr Sebastian Tallahr Software Analyst 23rd August 2010*), using *Tab* to move from cell to cell.
5. Give the table visible borders (*Table Design* > *Borders* > *All Borders*) and keep it within the margins.

The table appears between the body of the letter and the signature of the Director.

questions.enonce_markdown: Add header "M & M Computing " and footer "job interview"  *[2 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown: *Insert* tab > **Header** > **Edit Header**: type **M & M Computing**, then *Close Header and Footer*; *Insert* tab > **Footer** > **Edit Footer**: type **job interview** and close. One mark for the header, one mark for the footer.

questions.enonce_markdown: Save your work as Task 1 in your working directory, and print a copy
questions.corrige_markdown: *File* > **Save As**, choose the working directory (the *Candidate folder*), type the name **Task 1** and save. Then *File* > **Print**, check the preview (portrait, A4) and print one copy for the question booklet. No mark is printed for this step.
